measuredQuantities.label: Wasserstand
measuredQuantities.definition: Water level of a river or lake at a gauge, above the gauge zero or above sea level.

measuredQuantities.label: Abfluss
measuredQuantities.definition: Volume of water passing a gauge per second.

measuredQuantities.label: Ortsdosisleistung (ODL)
measuredQuantities.definition: Ambient gamma dose rate at a measuring station.

modelQuantities.label: Temperatur
modelQuantities.definition: Air temperature from a weather model, not a measurement.

modelQuantities.label: Luftqualitätsindex
modelQuantities.definition: European air quality index from an air quality model, not a measurement.

modelQuantities.label: Pollenkonzentration
modelQuantities.definition: Pollen grains per cubic metre of air from a pollen model (CAMS), not a measurement.

warningCategories.label: Bevölkerungsschutz
warningCategories.definition: Warning of civil protection, e.g. via MoWaS.

warningCategories.label: Polizei
warningCategories.definition: Message of the police, e.g. a search or a dangerous situation (NINA).

warningCategories.label: Hochwasser
warningCategories.definition: Flood message of a state flood centre (Länderübergreifendes Hochwasserportal, NINA).

newsCategories.label: Unwetter
newsCategories.definition: News about severe weather and natural hazards.

newsCategories.label: Konflikte
newsCategories.definition: News about armed conflicts and security.

newsCategories.label: Infrastruktur
newsCategories.definition: News about outages of supply, transport and communication.
